evidence.WCIL: Incorporated in 1972, Western Carriers (India) Ltd provides end-to-end supply chain management Business Overview: WCIL is a Multi-modal, rail-focused, 4PL asset-light logistics company with a specialization in customized end-to-end supply chain solutions.
